admin.reverse.full_sentence.other: %[1]s %[2]s go back from %[3]s to %[4]s. This reverses everything that is left, so the trade becomes Reversed.

admin.reverse.partial_sentence.other: %[1]s %[2]s go back from %[3]s to %[4]s. This is a partial reversal; the trade stays Completed.

admin.reset.forbidden.other: Not done. This password cannot be reset here. Use Change password for your own account, or ask the platform operator for help. Nothing changed.

time_zone.display.other: Pages show times in your time zone. The API and the audit log always use UTC. Now it is %[1]s in %[2]s.

time_zone.hint.other: An IANA name such as Europe/Berlin, Asia/Kolkata or America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires. Leave empty for UTC.

time_zone.invalid_summary.other: Not saved. Fix the problem below. Nothing changed.

time_zone.invalid_field.other: Time zone: enter a name such as Europe/Berlin or America/Mexico_City, or leave it empty for UTC.

dispute.category.quality.other: Not as described or poor quality

dispute.category.unauthorised.other: I did not agree to this trade

dispute.invalid.other: Not sent. Fix the problems below. Nothing changed.

dispute.statement.required.other: Statement: write what went wrong, in up to 2000 characters.

dispute.statement.too_long.other: Statement: this is too long. Shorten it to 2000 characters or fewer.

dispute.category.required.other: Reason: choose one of the reasons.

dispute.not_eligible.other: Not sent. This trade cannot be disputed now: it must be completed, the dispute deadline must not have passed, and you must be a party to it. Nothing changed.

dispute.opened.other: Dispute opened. The trade is marked Disputed. Your balance has not changed.

dispute.withdrawn.other: Dispute withdrawn. The trade is Completed again and nothing was posted.

dispute.responded.other: Your response was added. The reviewer and the other party can read it.

dispute.rereview_requested.other: Re-review requested. A different reviewer will look at the decision. This can only be done once.

dispute.not_eligible_deadline.other: Not sent. This trade cannot be disputed now: it must be completed, on or before its dispute deadline (%s), and you must be a party to it. Nothing changed.

dispute.outcome.dismissed.other: Dismissed: the balance stands as before.

dispute.outcome.upheld_pending.other: Upheld: a reversal of %s %s is decided but not yet posted.

dispute.outcome.upheld_posted.other: Upheld: a reversal of %s %s has been posted.

dispute.outcome.partial_pending.other: Partly upheld: a reversal of %s %s is decided but not yet posted.

dispute.outcome.partial_posted.other: Partly upheld: a reversal of %s %s has been posted.

dispute.form.deadline.other: You can open a dispute on this trade until %s.

dispute.form.completed_only.other: Only a completed trade can be disputed.

dispute.form.no_balance_change.other: Opening a dispute does not change any balance.

dispute.form.effect.other: The trade will be marked Disputed. Your balance and available credit do not change until a reviewer decides.

dispute.response_late.other: (no response yet; a reviewer will assess the case, silence decides nothing)

dispute.rereview_explanation.other: You can ask once for a different reviewer to look at this decision, until %s. The original decision is kept; the re-review is recorded next to it.

dispute.empty.other: You have no disputes. To contest a completed trade, open it from your %s and choose Raise a dispute.

dispute.waive_response.other: Decide without waiting for the other party's response

dispute.statement_hint.other: Up to 2000 characters. The other party and the reviewer will read this.

dispute.rereview_independent.other: You are not the reviewer who made the original decision.

dispute.rereview_upheld_option.other: Upheld: reverse what is still reversible

dispute.response_hint.other: Up to 2000 characters. You can respond once. The reviewer and the person who opened the dispute will read it.

dispute.rereview_reason_label.other: Why should it be looked at again?

dispute.rationale_hint.other: Required. Both parties will see it.

dispute.waive_hint.other: Needed only if the response period has not ended and no response was given. It is recorded in the audit trail.

dispute.amount_hint.other: Amount in credits, up to %d decimal places.

dispute.queue.independence.other: You cannot decide a dispute on a trade you took part in.

dispute.queue.empty.other: The queue is empty. Disputes that need a decision appear here.
